description: This source file provides database maintenance utilities for the Sports Telecast Backend, including functions for inspecting and managing Postgres advisory locks, performing Alembic migrations, diagnosing initial schema state, and repairing migration issues. It primarily supports schema migration, lock management, and initial setup routines.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _get_lock_key_pair(key: int)
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit advisory lock key into PostgreSQL's internal (classid, objid) pair.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] inspect_locks(engine: Engine = sync_engine)
methods.description: Inspects current Postgres advisory locks and blocked sessions, returning counts and details.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] clear_advisory_lock_holders(lock_key: Optional[str] = None, engine: Engine = sync_engine)
methods.description: Terminates sessions holding or waiting on a specific advisory lock key. Defaults to environment variable if not provided.

methods.name: Config _alembic_config()
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Alembic configuration object pointing to the project's migration directory.

methods.name: None alembic_reset()
methods.description: Resets the Alembic version table by truncating it, effectively clearing migration history.

methods.name: None alembic_stamp_base()
methods.description: Stamps the database at the 'base' migration revision without applying migrations.

methods.name: None alembic_upgrade(revision: str = "head")
methods.description: Upgrades the database schema to the specified revision (default 'head').

methods.name: bool _table_exists(conn, table_name: str)
methods.description: Checks if a specific table exists in the public schema.

methods.name: List[str] _fetch_alembic_versions(conn)
methods.description: Fetches the current versions recorded in the alembic_version table.

methods.name: Set[str] _initial_expected_tables()
methods.description: Returns a set of table names expected from the initial migration (001).

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _inspect_initial_schema(conn)
methods.description: Inspects and reports which of the initial migration tables are present or missing.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] run_diagnose_001_migration(timeout_seconds: int = 180, engine: Engine = sync_engine)
methods.description: Runs a diagnostic and monitoring routine during the initial migration (001), collecting lock and activity info.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] diagnose_initial_state(engine: Engine = sync_engine)
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive diagnosis of advisory locks and initial migration schema state.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] repair_initial_migration(lock_key: Optional[str] = None, engine: Engine = sync_engine)
methods.description: Diagnoses and attempts to repair issues related to the initial migration (001), including lock clearance and reapplication of migration steps.

ctags.name: clear_advisory_lock_holders
ctags.pattern: /^def clear_advisory_lock_holders(lock_key: Optional[str] = None, engine: Engine = sync_engine) ->/

ctags.name: repair_initial_migration
ctags.pattern: /^def repair_initial_migration(lock_key: Optional[str] = None, engine: Engine = sync_engine) -> Di/

ctags.name: sync_engine
ctags.pattern: /^from .connection import engine as sync_engine  # uses sync engine for admin ops$/
